order: Fix a silent agent-load failure affecting the cross-vendor pack's three agent definitions. Diagnose why the harness drops these agents silently instead of raising an error — a bare colon-space sequence inside an unquoted description field makes the frontmatter unparseable, and the harness's own repair pass cannot be relied on to recover it, since it is defeated outright by a Windows-line-ending checkout, let alone a clean one. Fix each of the three affected agent files with a one-word rewording of the offending description text — do not restructure the frontmatter, do not add quoting, and touch nothing else in any of the three files; a minimal wording change is exactly enough to eliminate the bare colon and restore parseability. Keep the fix scoped to these three files that silently failed to load; every other agent definition in the pack stays byte-identical.
claims: We traced the silent agent-load failure to a bare colon-space sequence inside an unquoted description field, which the harness's frontmatter repair pass cannot fix under a Windows-line-ending checkout. A one-word rewording in each of the exactly three affected files removes the bare colon and restores parseability, for three insertions and three deletions total, with every other line in those files left unchanged. We confirmed the frontmatter now parses for all three agent definitions.
